definitions.bare: No owner (TODO(name) naming a commit author, or an @mention of one), no link (issue/PR reference, URL, tracker key), no date, no version, no strict condition (an event to wait for: 'once X is released', 'remove when Y lands', 'blocked on Z') and no unicorn [condition].
definitions.bareLoose: bare, and also none of the condition words once/when/whenever/after/until/unless/as soon as/pending/blocked on/waiting for/depends on anywhere in its text (they also describe code, so this undercounts bare TODOs).
definitions.paren: TODO(x): issue (#n, URL, number), key (a tracker key such as NAR-804), date, person (every word is a commit author's name, first name, email local part or GitHub login in the history clone), topic (anything else), empty.
definitions.marker: A term written in capitals, the JSDoc @todo tag, a term followed by ':' '(' '[' or a dash, or a term opening the comment (or a block comment's line). TODO, FIXME and TBD are markers anywhere. 'Note that…', 'review the…' and the like at the start of a sentence are prose; terms inside paths or words (foo.xxx, /xxx/) are embedded.
definitions.position: start: only whitespace before the term in the comment (no-warning-comments' default location); start-decorated: only whitespace and * / ! # = + - before it; line-start: the start of a later line of a block comment; later: anywhere else.
definitions.ruleTerms: TODO, FIXME, XXX (the default terms of no-warning-comments and unicorn/expiring-todo-comments).
definitions.taskMarkers: TODO, FIXME, XXX, @todo, TO DO, TBD, HACK, BUG.
definitions.text: The rest of the marker's comment line, plus the lines that continue it (next lines of a block comment, adjacent // comments at the same column), up to a blank line or another marker.
definitions.wordingWithoutMarker: Comments with no marker that use hack/hacky/workaround/kludge/temporary/for now/ugly/quick fix/stopgap/band-aid (a rough indicator only).
